answer_text:
A strong, Gulf-friendly option is **Sephora Middle East (Sephora.ae / Sephora.sa)**—it’s widely used across the GCC, carries a lot of bridal-appropriate brands (makeup, skincare, fragrance, hair tools), and typically has reliable local delivery/returns compared with many international-only sites.

Other solid options (depending on which Gulf country you’re in):
- **Namakaa (UAE)**: bridal-focused beauty services/products and curated picks (more “wedding” oriented than a general beauty retailer).
- **Boots (UAE / KSA, online)**: dependable for skincare, haircare, and supplements; good if you want practical “bridal prep” items.
- **Ounass (UAE, delivers GCC)**: higher-end beauty and fragrance, strong for luxury gifts and premium brands.
- **Noon (UAE/KSA)**: convenient and fast, but stick to items marked **sold by Noon / authorized sellers** to avoid authenticity issues.

If you tell me **which GCC country** (UAE, KSA, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman) and whether you’re buying **makeup vs skincare vs hair tools**, I can narrow it to the best 1–2 stores for delivery speed and brand availability.
